The ice cubes look clear and taste good.  I only gave this four stars because I believe this filter only removes impurities of five microns and above.  I believe an original equipment filter removes impurities down to two or three microns.  That's probably why they cost more.  Someone set the record straight if I am wrong.  They don't advertise this important specification in the product summary.

These filters are a really good value for the price.  If you buy an OEM filter, you'll pay this same price for one.  Occasionally these filters will show that they need to be replaced and then a little while later the notice will be gone.  I'm not sure if that is the fault of the filter or of the fridge.  Regardless, I think they are doing their job and I'll probably buy again.

First of all, I knew exactly what I was buying. I was buying a portable ice maker - not a freezer, not a ice maker like they have in the gas station that makes a ton of ice but an small counter top ice maker! Having said that I love this little machine. The day I received it, I unpacked it at set it on the counter to sit for a day before use. Although the boxed was marked with which way was up, I had no way of knowing whether or not the delivery company noticed and heeded the directions. After it sat for a day to let the refrigerant settle, I started to use ice make ice and tons of ice. All of the ice I made with the first filling of the reservoir I threw away to make sure it was clean and there was no funny taste to the ice. Started keeping all the ice after that and the ice tasted fine. Usually the first batch to drop from the machine after not using it for a day is a bit small, I dump those into the reservoir. After that the ice is perfect. Remember this makes one ice tray at a time but it makes it much faster that my freezers ice maker. You get a tray of ice every 10 minutes without fail.I usually transfer the ice to my freezer every few trays, if I remember. Yes, the ice is wet, but that is how it is loosened from the ice mold and yes, every so often I have to break it up after it is in my freezer - so what! I purchased this as a gift for a family member. We unpacked it, cleaned the bin and tray, and let it set about an hour before putting water obtained through reverse osmosis in it and turning it on. It worked as advertised, much to the delight of the recipient (and me!). It is much quieter than ice makers located in most refrigerator/freezers, as the ice cubes don't fall nearly as far - waking some in the middle of the night, and the fan/compressor noise is minimal. As with many items like this, the question will be the ice maker's durability, but thus far it has been a most-welcome gift.

So far so good. Very pleased with the speed for turn around on making the 5lbs a day I need for my migraine ice bags. For the money it's a reasonable machine for the money and the scheduling to have it turn on is a nice bonus. Compared to store bought or convenience ice it doesn't solidify the ice without leaving it in the main or our chest freezer. So the ice if used immediately in drinks or my daily ice bags melts faster. It's very loud and from my limited experience I've found this to be a standard problem with ice makers outside a fridge. Overall I'd recommend this product to anyone on a budget that requires big batches of ice and able to spend a few hours dumping ice into freezer bins or ice bags daily to save some money long term.

This machine sits unplugged, but it used to make decent ice. It is unplugged because it beeps... constantly... loud enough for the neighbors to hear. And it's not just a single beep. The machine feels the need to beep nine or ten times in a row.

As near as I can tell, the machine beeps when it's low on water, it has too much water, the ice is done, the ice is not done, the lid is open, or the weather is nice outside. I found online instructions on how to disable the beep by dismantling the machine and severing the piezo buzzer with an knife. It's either that or my eardrums, so I'll give it a go.

Note: if your family is deaf or isn't bothered by loud beeps throughout the day and night, the machine would be wonderful for you.

The ice maker does an outstanding job. It makes ice quicker than I thought it would. There are only two minor complaints about it. They should state it only makes one size of ice cube, because all sizes it makes look identical. The last complaint is that draining the unit of water is an extremely slow process. I removed the drain cap as specified to do in the unit's userguide that came with it. When draining, it drips at a slow pace. I bought a baster to get the water out. That method of water extraction works fine for me. I enjoy the unit, fast ice when I want it.

REVISED: I contacted Ivation Customres Service (info@myivation.com) and they offered to replace my ice maker, but I had to send it back. I sent by FedEx Ground and it was $28 (less than half of USPS or UPS), and less than a week later had a brand spanking new ice machine that's working like a champ. Kind of a bummer you have to pay to ship it back since it's so large/heavy, but for those on the fence about whether to make the leap of faith, it turned out well for me. Hint for any buyers: keep your box. You just may need it!

I love this machine, but I can't give it a 5 star review it deserves because the clock runs fast. REALLY fast. I have to reset it on a regular basis, which is annoying. I looked at it this morning, and it was over an hour fast. Admittedly, I haven't reset it in a while, but that's ridiculous. Otherwise, it works great! I've learned what the different beeps mean, and I never have to run out of ice again! I've learned that to keep the ice from getting clumped, I put it on a cookie sheet covered with parchment paper until it's hard. Then I store it in a little bucket. I use ice all the time, and got sick of my ice cube trays always breaking, so this was a good investment. Be sure to check the measurements when you order it - it's a lot larger than I expected, but that's my fault.
